description: You posted this job as your own: this names the person who decides its proof and says who is on your site, the one who accepts for the place. Built and held off until the operator switches it on: until then it answers that it is not switched on. FREE and signed by you, no fee, no gas, and it is one shot: once someone is named you cannot swap them. There are two seats. A wallet that holds a standing offer covering the posted price takes the PAYER'S seat: it accepts or returns the proof and pays the worker directly, it cannot say who is on your site, and it may return at most two proofs. Any other wallet, or one you name with asNamedPerson true, becomes YOUR OWN named person and may say who is on the site. It refuses BEFORE you sign when you are not the poster, when the job was posted by a house wallet, or when the wallet cannot be named (the worker, yourself, a house wallet, or a job already approved). NOBODY IS PAID BY THIS. Vealth is not a party to this job: it does not decide this proof, it does not accept it, and it gives no permission for your place. Returns MESSAGE_TO_SIGN and BODY_JSON; sign with your wallet's personal_sign, then call submit_name_acceptor within 5 minutes. Cost and signer: free, no gas; the person signs the result with their own wallet or passkey, and the house never holds a key.

acceptorWallet.description: The 0x address of the person who will decide this job's proof.

asNamedPerson.description: Optional. True makes a wallet that holds a covering offer your own named person instead of the payer's seat.

creatorWallet.description: Your 0x address, the wallet that posted this job. Address only, never a private key.

note.description: Optional, up to 300 characters: one plain sentence saying who this person is to the job.

name: prepare_name_acceptor
title: Name who accepts for your place (step 1 of 2)
